task_title: Make the Floor 2 settlement hallway safe

plan_review.notes: Approved with detail changes. C1: gate exact tile-index metadata on the persisted settlement snapshot, whose creation is all-or-nothing after room activation. C2: repaint only stored internal non-door connector tiles during settlement initialization; internal doors remain DOOR. C3: add same-map pre/post initialization safety coverage. C4: use ReadonlySet<number> flat indices for allocation-free hot-path lookup. C5: assert both internal doorway tiles safe and both exterior doors plus adjacent cave approaches unsafe. No different architecture warranted.
